moral.zh: 翅膀的形状和动作让空气产生升力与推力，羽毛、胸肌和轻而结实的骨骼一起帮助鸟飞行。
moral.en: Wing shape and movement create lift and thrust, while feathers, strong muscles and light bones help birds fly.

pages.zhText: 公园里，一只小鸟扑棱着飞走。米米抬头问：“鸟为什么会飞？”
pages.enText: In the park, a little bird flaps up and away. Mimi looks up and asks, “Why can birds fly?”

pages.enText: A wing has a curved shape. As it moves through the air, it pushes air downward.

pages.enText: Feathers shape the wings, strong chest muscles power the flaps, and a light, sturdy skeleton helps too. They all work together.
